contentSection.heading: How I Collaborate
contentSection.paragraph1: I work with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. I adapt quickly to existing codebases and established workflows. My first weeks go into understanding the business domain and the project's architectural decisions. I prefer contributing with incremental improvements and clear code over making large changes without context.
contentSection.paragraph2: I value teams that prioritize software quality, automated testing, and well-reasoned technical decisions. I write tests — first when fixing bugs, after for new features. In code review I focus on clarity, edge cases, and consistency. I design CI/CD pipelines with linter, type-checking, and parallel tests, plus deployments with health checks.
contentSection.paragraph3: I don't need constant supervision and take ownership of what I build. I also know when to ask for help. I prefer direct communication and technical discussions documented in PRs over long meetings.
